description: INSTAT, the national statistics institute of Madagascar, published 18 thematic reports and a demographic atlas from its third General Population and Housing Census (RGPH-3) of 2018. Theme 5, on housing and living environment, has tables in percent by urban or rural area and by region on building type, dominant floor, wall and roof materials, drinking water service, electricity service, safely managed toilets and waste disposal. The report states that 29.5 percent of dwellings were served with drinking water and 38.1 percent used electricity for lighting. The RGPH-3 page also links a household database in SPSS format, a 10 percent sample of census households, and a larger resident database. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF reports and SPSS files through Google Drive links, no registration seen. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: report tables are in PDF; the sample file needs weighting; the INSTAT homepage carried injected spam links when read, so links should be checked before use. Simulation uses: roof and wall materials by region for cyclone damage models and service coverage for electrification planning. Related records: IPUMS International and the WorldPop population grid.
